title: Jubilant Malty Egyptian Durum Wheat Flatbread
description: A satvik-friendly Egyptian dish featuring malty flavors and aerated texture, perfect for a solo dinner, this flatbread is made with caster sugar and durum wheat flour, kneaded to perfection
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine durum wheat flour, caster sugar, active dry yeast, malt powder, and salt
Gradually add warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal portions
Roll out each portion into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick
Brush the tops with olive oil and cook for 2 minutes on each side, until golden brown
